title: Going Beneath the Surface: Evaluating Image Captioning for Grammaticality, Truthfulness and Diversity
answer_short: As the ratio of observed number versus optimal number of language constructions used.
answer_rationale: Diversity in the GTD evaluation framework is measured by comparing the observed number of language constructions used in generated captions to the optimal number, which is determined by the sampled reference captions. This is explicitly defined in the diversity section of the GTD Evaluation Framework, where language constructions are reduced representations that capture whether an object is described by shape, color, or color-shape combination, and diversity is computed as the ratio of observed to optimal number.
